title: The Read Receipt
description: The message you sent three years ago — the one that ended everything — just switched to 'read.' Someone is typing.

n1.caption: 3:17 AM. The message you sent three years ago — the one that ended everything — just switched to read. Three dots are pulsing.

n2a.caption: One line: 'I kept your copy of the key. The garden gate still sticks. — M'

n2b.caption: You last ten minutes before it buzzes again. A photo: the garden gate, ajar, lit by the porch light you installed yourself.

n3a.caption: Forty minutes later she's on the porch with two glasses, like no time passed at all. 'You read it this time,' she says.

n3b.caption: Her reply lands before you finish typing: 'Because the house sells Monday. Whatever we didn't say gets boxed up with it.'

n3c.caption: You stare at 'I'm not coming' until the screen dims. Then you delete it and write the truth: 'Be there in forty minutes.'
